theorems.name: Submission.iwl_cr_hp_lift_gram_det
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (G : Eucl m → Eucl P) (Gt : Eucl (m + 1) → Eucl (P + 1)) (w : Eucl (m + 1)) (b : Eucl m), (∀ v : Eucl (m + 1), Gt v = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ v 0) (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ (G ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ v))))))) → b = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ w)) → DifferentiableAt ℝ G b → (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Gt w (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Gt w (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det = (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin m => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G b (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ G b (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det
